audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Yasuo Level 1 and Level 6 and gave Quinn the 2+ item row, while the whys beside those exact rows say the opposite: whys[0] 'your range and Harrier auto-resets own level 1', whys[4] 'R is a tempo/roam window... his crit spike hasn't arrived', whys[6] 'he out-scales hard'.
audit.why: 52.88% over 728 games and the packet chart is Quinn rows 0-5, Yasuo row 6. Three rows rendered a different answer than the sentence underneath them.
audit.corrected: Quinn rows 0-5, Yasuo row 6, both layers.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Quinn owns Lvl 1-3, R is roam tempo, first item is the last clean all-in, and Yasuo's window is IE plus Phantom Dancer at 2+ items. Last Breath at 70s rank 1 down to 30s at rank 3 is why the late game compounds against you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Wall is named on every panel but never quantified, and Last Breath's prerequisite is never stated. The reader is told to 'track Wind Wall' with no idea how long the hole is.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s for a 4-second wall, so at rank 1 baiting it buys a 21-second window — that is the whole matchup. Last Breath only exists off an Airborne target, and Steel Tempest needs two stacks of Gathering Storm to produce the knockup, so the knockup is the thing to dodge, not the ultimate.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s maxed, 4s duration — bait it and fight in the 21-second hole. Last Breath: 70s at rank 1 and it needs a knockup first, so two Steel Tempest stacks are the real tell.
sources: enemyKit Q knockup and Gathering Storm text

notes: Two data problems worth knowing. (1) Quinn's Q carries no 'projectile' flag in her kit file, yet the page — correctly, in my judgement — says Wind Wall blocks it; the flag looks like a tooltip-parsing miss, so I left the existing claim standing rather than weaken it. (2) Yasuo's Wind Wall carries a 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag, but Riot's own description says only 'blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds'. Per the trust-the-description rule I did NOT write anything claiming Wind Wall stops Quinn's Vault, and nothing on the page currently does. The itemization panel recommends anti-heal because 'his healing fights your pattern' — Yasuo's kit has no healing, so that clause is boilerplate from another matchup and needs a manual fix.
